name: &Love
source:
Ryo lives a cheerful school life with his friends. But one day, he receives a big package from his father. When he opens it, an android girl tumbles out of the box!? Though he doesn't know what's going on, he starts living with her, Mil. What Ryo teaches her first is to wear underwear.... Like this, his life with Mil starts....

[From ErogeShop]
